projection_rules.authoritative_document_status: Project the document status and boundary statuses without reinterpretation.

entries.name: DNA OS Engineering Runtime Coding Gate
entries.destination_system: DNA OS Engineering Runtime isolated worktree and LOCAL coding worker
authority: ENGINEERING authority path only. DNA OS chooses repository, worktree, and branch. The model/worker cannot expand allowed_paths or write repository_root.
READ / OPERATE / DOCUMENTATION capabilities have zero source-write authority and cannot enter this path.
Missing allowed_paths, empty required_tests, missing forbidden_paths, or ambiguous/missing repository identity refuse admission before worker dispatch.
May request scoped writes inside an isolated worktree. COMMIT=DENY PUSH=DENY PR=DENY DEPLOY=DENY. Cannot copy into the registered checkout, commit, push, or hold a GitHub credential.

DNA OS independently compares original intent, registered repository, reservation, allowed paths/symbols, actual diff, forbidden paths, required tests, and manifest hashes. Worker self-report is not trusted.
After Admission=ALLOW, DNA OS copies only admitted paths from the worktree into the registered source repository and records registry/evidence.
DNA OS only. After local VERIFIED integration, DNA OS creates a commit-tree of admitted paths parented at the registered default branch. Worker-supplied git commit commands are refused.
DNA OS only. Pushes the DNA OS-created commit to the registered GitHub destination resolved from repository_id. No force push. No worker token.

DENIED_BY_ARCHITECTURE. External AI may produce structured Engineering Intent and submit through DNA OS Tool/Authority. It may not select repository paths as authority, write source, commit, push, use GitHub write credentials, or deploy.
NOT_WIRED. No Supabase/Vercel/Railway/DigitalOcean production deploy.
known_gaps: Pull Request creation is NOT_WIRED
production deploy (Supabase/Vercel/Railway/DigitalOcean) is NOT_WIRED
continueRegisteredArtifact remains a legacy Contents path that is DNA_OS_PUBLISH_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED for this registered repository
entries.next_required_connection: Do not wire DEPLOYMENT_AUTHORITY, Pull Request automation, or Contents write. GITHUB_PUBLISH is live-verified: DNA_OS_COMMIT_SHA equals REMOTE_POST_PUBLISH_SHA.
entries.owner_visible_summary: Engineering Runtime is the coding and source-publication authority path. CODING, ADMISSION, LOCAL_INTEGRATION, DNA_OS_COMMIT, GITHUB_PUBLISH, OWNER_EVIDENCE_PIPELINE, and DISPLAY_QUEUE are live-verified. EXTERNAL_AI_SOURCE_WRITE is DENIED_BY_ARCHITECTURE. DEPLOYMENT remains NOT_WIRED.
